title: GitLab 全员会议怎样分享信息、回答问题
topic: GitLab 全员会议怎样分享信息、回答问题

source.title: GitLab All-Company Meetings | The GitLab Handbook
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 GitLab 公开资料。
paragraphs: GitLab internal-only company meetings align team members on key initiatives, business updates, and priorities across the business. At the start of our fiscal year, a company kickoff (CKO) meeting is held followed by 1x per quarter company-wide Assembly meetings. Ask Me Anything (AMA) Sessions will happen three times per quarter. This page provides an overview of each of these.
Earnings Call (first half of the second month of the quarter): Public call that team members are invited to attend
Post-Earnings Recap & AMA (immediately following earnings): A 25 minute private AMA occurring after Earnings
Recordings and agendas (internal only) listed in reverse chronological order.
Held the week of our quarterly Earnings Call, the Post-Earnings Recap & AMA is an opportunity for team members to ask questions related to our Financial Results.
For more information about our quarterly Earnings process, visit the Investor Relations Handbook page.
The Post-Earnings Recap & AMA is a Finance initiative.
GitLab Assembly is our quarterly all-company meeting and is an opportunity for team members to hear from leaders and teams across the company.
To learn more about GitLab Assembly, visit the Assembly section of the People Communications & team member engagement Handbook page.
translations: GitLab内部公司会议旨在协调团队成员对关键举措、业务更新和业务优先事项的认识。在我们的财年开始时，会举行公司启动会议（CKO），随后每季度举行1次全体员工大会会议。问答环节（AMA）每季度举行三次。本页面概述了这些会议的每一项。
财报电话会议（每季度第二个月的前半部分）：团队成员受邀参加的公开电话会议
财报回顾与问答（紧接着财报之后）：在财报后举行的25分钟私人问答环节
按倒序排列的录音和议程（仅限内部）。
在我们季度财报电话会议的那一周举行，财报回顾与问答环节是团队成员就我们的财务结果提问的机会。
有关我们季度财报流程的更多信息，请访问投资者关系手册页面。
财报回顾与问答是财务部门的倡议。
GitLab大会是我们每季度的全体员工会议，是团队成员听取公司各层领导和团队发言的机会。
要了解更多关于GitLab大会的信息，请访问人员沟通与员工参与手册页面的大会部分。

notes.explain: 这是一种开放式的问答会议形式，参与者可以就任何相关问题提问
notes.example: Our company hosts monthly AMA sessions where employees can directly ask executives about company strategy.

notes.explain: 这是在财报发布后举行的内部问答会议，专门回答与财务结果相关的问题
notes.example: After the quarterly earnings announcement, the CFO will lead a Post-Earnings Recap & AMA to address any questions from the team.

notes.phrase: ask questions related to our Financial Results
notes.meaning: 询问与我们财务结果相关的问题
notes.explain: 这是专门针对财务数据的问答环节，员工可以就公司财务表现提问
notes.example: During the finance briefing, team members are encouraged to ask questions related to our Financial Results for the past quarter.

notes.phrase: hear from leaders and teams across the company
notes.meaning: 听取公司各领导和团队的分享
notes.explain: 这是全员会议中让不同部门领导和团队分享信息、更新进展的环节
notes.example: The all-hands meeting provides an opportunity for employees to hear from leaders and teams across the company about upcoming projects.

scenario.title: Explaining the purpose of a company-wide meeting
english: A teammate missed the latest company-wide Assembly and asks what these meetings are for.
The handbook says company-wide meetings align team members on key initiatives, business updates, and priorities.
You explain the purpose and point out that the handbook lists Ask Me Anything sessions three times per quarter.
chinese: 一位同事错过了最近一次全员 Assembly，来问这类会议是做什么的。
手册说明，全员会议用于同步重要事项、业务更新和公司优先级。
你向同事解释会议目的，并说明手册列出的 Ask Me Anything 问答场次为每季度三次。

firstAttempt.prompt: 一位同事准备参加下次 GitLab 全员会议，想知道会议用途和提问机会。请用英文说明会议帮助大家对齐什么，并准确说出手册列出的问答环节和频次。
firstAttempt.sample: Company-wide meetings align team members on key initiatives, business updates, and priorities. The handbook lists Ask Me Anything sessions for employee questions, and these take place three times per quarter.
firstAttempt.rationale: 准确说明全员会议的沟通目的和手册列出的员工提问机会。

words.example: We'll have a project kickoff meeting next Monday to align on objectives and timelines.
words.translation: 我们将在下周一举行项目启动会议，就目标和时间线达成一致。
words.note: kickoff通常用于项目或活动开始前的首次会议，旨在明确目标和方向。

words.example: The quarterly assembly is where important company announcements are made.
words.translation: 季度全体会议是发布重要公司公告的场合。
words.note: 在GitLab语境中，Assembly特指其季度全员会议形式。

words.example: The company's quarterly earnings exceeded market expectations.
words.translation: 该公司的季度收益超过了市场预期。
words.note: 在商业语境中，earnings通常指公司的财务收益或盈利情况。

words.example: Please send me a recap of today's strategy meeting by tomorrow.
words.translation: 请于明天前发送今天战略会议的回顾摘要给我。
words.note: Recap是recapitation的缩写，常用于会议或活动后的总结回顾。

words.example: Regular team building activities help improve employee engagement.
words.translation: 定期团队建设活动有助于提高员工参与度。
words.note: 在职场中，engagement常用来描述员工对工作的投入程度和参与感。

words.example: This meeting is internal-only, so please don't share the information outside the company.
words.translation: 这次会议仅限内部，请不要将信息分享给公司外部人员。
words.note: internal-only强调信息或活动的保密性，仅限组织内部人员参与。

structure.original: GitLab internal-only company meetings align team members on key initiatives, business updates, and priorities across the business.
analysis: "GitLab internal-only company meetings" 是名词短语作主语，其中"internal-only"是复合形容词修饰"company meetings"，表示这些会议仅限公司内部人员参加
"align team members on key initiatives, business updates, and priorities" 是动词短语作谓语，其中"align"是及物动词，"on"引导的介词短语表示"在...方面达成一致"，后面接三个并列的名词短语作宾语："key initiatives"、"business updates"和"priorities"
"across the business"是介词短语作状语，修饰整个谓语部分，表示这些会议覆盖整个企业的范围
structure.transfer: Our quarterly all-hands meetings align employees on strategic goals, departmental progress, and organizational priorities across the company.

rewrite.bad: The all-hands is mainly for sales results. Employees cannot ask questions during it.
rewrite.good: Company-wide meetings align team members on key initiatives, business updates, and priorities. The handbook lists Ask Me Anything sessions three times per quarter for questions.
rewrite.translation: 全员会议帮助团队了解重要项目、业务更新和优先事项。手册还列出每季度三次 Ask Me Anything 提问环节。
rewrite.pattern: Company-wide meetings cover [purpose]. The handbook also lists [the question opportunities].

cloze.prompt: Company-wide meetings align team members ___ key initiatives and priorities.
cloze.why: align on 表示围绕某事达成共同了解。

cloze.prompt: The handbook lists Ask Me Anything sessions for employee ___.
Ask Me Anything sessions take place three times per ___.
cloze.why: 准确写出每季度的次数。

dictation.text: Sarah, a marketing coordinator, needs to present quarterly campaign results during the all-hands meeting while addressing questions from various departments.
dictation.why: 听清句中的工作任务、动作和时间信息。

dictation.text: She faces constraints: limited time slot, technical team's focus on metrics versus creative team's emphasis on brand storytelling, and executives wanting concise data.
dictation.why: 听清句中的工作任务、动作和时间信息。

translationPractice.prompt: 全员会议帮助团队成员了解重要事项、业务更新和优先级。
translationPractice.answer: Company-wide meetings align team members on key initiatives, business updates, and priorities.
translationPractice.why: 用 align on 概括全员会议让员工对齐的信息。

translationPractice.prompt: Ask Me Anything 环节每季度举行三次。
translationPractice.answer: Ask Me Anything sessions take place three times per quarter.
translationPractice.why: 准确表达手册列出的问答频次。

choice.prompt: 同事问全员会议的目的是什么。请用英文写两句：说明会议用途，并指出手册列出的提问机会。
options: I don't know why sales didn't increase. Maybe the product wasn't good enough.
Company-wide meetings align team members on key initiatives, business updates, and priorities. The handbook lists Ask Me Anything sessions three times per quarter for questions.
They guarantee that every team will meet its quarterly sales target.
choice.why: 第一句说明全员会议用途，第二句补充手册列出的提问安排。

output.prompt: 你要在全员会上介绍一个新客户支持流程。请用英文用三句话说明流程解决什么问题、从何时开始试行，以及员工在哪里提问或反馈。
output.sample: The new support process will make it easier to route urgent customer issues to the right team. We’ll begin a two-week pilot on Monday. Please add questions to the shared Q&A document, and we’ll address them during the next Ask Me Anything session.
check: 是否说明新流程解决的问题？
是否交代试行开始时间？
是否指明员工提问或反馈的渠道？
